zxing-wasm 3.1.4 — MIT (JavaScript wrapper)
https://github.com/Sec-ant/zxing-wasm
See ZXING-WASM-LICENSE.

ZXing-C++ and ZXingWasm.cpp — Apache License 2.0
https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp
https://github.com/Sec-ant/zxing-wasm/tree/main/src/cpp
See ZXING-CPP-APACHE-2.0.
The reader-only WebAssembly build is used. Barcode writers are not included.
Unmodified upstream binary and JavaScript assets are redistributed.
